title: Close one no-go result
objective: Preserve one failed or impossible mechanism as terminal evidence so a later agent does not repeat it.
preconditions: A measured ceiling, stable no-win, boundary loss, or invalid mechanism
steps: Name the exact contract, shapes, contexts, mechanism, and evidence
Separate no-win from invalid measurement and infrastructure failure
Record attempted bounded variants and the causal reason they failed
State the only facts that may reopen the result: mechanism class, contract, hardware/stack, or production baseline

acceptance.pass: The knowledge entry is auditable and has one terminal disposition.
acceptance.invalid: The result lacks raw evidence or merely says more tuning is needed.

stop_rule: Do not reopen a no-go with more values of the same knob.
origin_evidence: Session history repeatedly reopened physical constants and bounded sweeps without a new causal mechanism.
